download-page:
WFSim for Windows

The same calculator on your own machine — it opens instantly, works with no connection, and keeps itself up to date. It is not a cut-down version: the engine is the same wasm module this site serves.

The first time you open it

  • Windows shows a blue notice, "Windows protected your PC". Click "More info", then "Run anyway".
  • It says that because this program has no code-signing certificate — one costs several thousand yuan a year, which a free tool does not justify. An antivirus warning is the same thing for the same reason: an unsigned program nobody has seen before.
  • If you would rather check first, the SHA-256 and the command to verify it ship in the notes beside the download. Or just use the site — it does everything this does.

Why install it

  • Nothing is downloaded when you open it. The engine is already on your disk, so a fight is computed the moment you ask for it — however slow this site is to reach from where you are.
  • It works with no connection at all.
  • It updates itself, and takes only what changed: a release touching one file is under a kilobyte on the wire. You download this once.
  • The site stays exactly where it is. Both run the same engine, and a build link opens in either.

What it is not

  • Not an installer. There is nothing to run as administrator, and nothing is written to the registry.
  • Not a second engine. It carries the same wasm the site serves, so a number is the same number in both.
  • Uninstalling is deleting the file. Its data sits in %LOCALAPPDATA%\WFSim and can go with it.

The source

  • AGPL-3.0. A source archive sits beside the download because the licence requires the source to be offered wherever the binary is — it is the same source that is on GitHub, and you do not need it to run the program. github.com/magenie33/wfsim
support-page:
Support WFSim

The Warframe calculator that matches the game, measured item by item. The calculator is free for everyone, and the same for everyone.

It does not score an opening state. It runs the engagement — every ramp, every reload, every status that had to land before the damage depending on it — and reports what happened.

How it works

  • How much of a grenade's damage was the impact and how much was the cloud it left behind is something the fight works out. It is not a ratio you type in.
  • A mod that stacks on kill starts the fight at zero stacks. It builds during the fight, expires, and decays — so the build's own numbers change while you are shooting.
  • How many Forma a build needs is computed, and so is whether it fits in the weapon at all.

Why you can check it

  • Every formula in the engine cites its source — a wiki page, a datamine, or a measurement — and every golden test is calibrated against a real in-game run.
  • It tells you what it cannot model, on the card where you are standing: on a weapon, an evolution, a mod, an arcane, an enemy. It lists those itself rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Sometimes it says the number is right and the game is wrong, and names the bug a hotfix would take away.
  • And if your own in-game measurement disagrees with it, the measurement wins. That is a bug report about reality, and it is the one thing that changes what this engine does.

Two ways to back it

WFSim Patron. For those who want to do the most for it. Everything a Member has, the Patron look, your name on the thanks page if you want it, and a seat where the work is discussed.

On Bilibili and YouTube. Back the videos where WFSim is built in the open. Nothing is sold there and nothing comes back but thanks — your name on the thanks page, if you want it.

The people who have backed it

    Everyone who has →

    The calculator is the same for everyone

    • An in-game measurement is the only thing that changes what the engine does, and it wins whoever reports it — so the way to move a number here is to go and measure one.
    • Building, simulating and optimizing are the same for everyone, and what guarantees that is not me: this is AGPL-3.0, so the engine, the game data and the wasm are public and you can run your own copy.
    • A fix to the builder, the simulator or the optimizer ships to everybody at once. There is no earlier copy.
    • There are no recommended builds here and no curated list. Every row on the board is what this engine computed under the benchmark's own pinned terms, so anyone with the repository reproduces the same number.
    • What you have run here stays in your own browser and is sent nowhere. The only place a visit is counted at all is Cloudflare's own request log, which is what serves the page.
    • A donation buys no priority: not over what gets built next, not in the queue, not on a reply. I will read your message knowing you backed this, and it would be dishonest to claim that changes nothing — but that is a courtesy, not an obligation, and it is the whole of what it is.

    What your backing makes possible

    • Time, most of all: every new weapon and mechanic, the day it lands.
    • The hours in game that every calibrated number is measured against.

    Free, and worth more

    • Report a number that disagrees with your own in-game measurement. That is the one contribution nothing else can replace — every formula here is calibrated against a real run, and a discrepancy is a bug report on reality. GitHub Issues · QQ group · Discord
    • Star the repository, or send a build link to someone who is still doing this by hand. github.com/magenie33/wfsim

    A donation is a gift and buys nobody an advantage. A membership renews until you cancel it, which takes one click from your account; within 14 days of any charge, ask and it is refunded in full.

    What is counted

    WFSim counts what gets used — which pages open, whether a build was computed, a simulation or a search started and finished, whether the page itself failed (the kind of failure, never its text), a board build opened, a link shared, how many presets and customs are saved — under a random id this browser keeps. The count records no IP address and sets no cookie, and the id is not linked to anything that identifies you. With Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track on, nothing is sent.
